data.one_liner: Physics-based gooey toast notifications for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides physics-driven gooey toasts with support for morphing shapes, promise handling, large cards with images and buttons, and touch or swipe gestures. It depends solely on the Flutter SDK and works across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need physics-based or gooey animated toast notifications in your app.
You want a notification system that supports promise handling and morphing states.
You are looking for a standalone toast implementation that does not require the Material Overlay.
avoid_when: You need standard system push or local notifications (use flutter_local_notifications instead).
You require Material-specific widgets like InkWell or Tooltip directly inside the toast description.
strengths: Smooth physics-based gooey animations and spring-driven morphing.
Comprehensive accessibility features including live regions and text scaling.
Zero external dependencies outside of the Flutter SDK.
weaknesses: Sits above the Navigator as a Stack rather than an Overlay, meaning standard Material widgets like Tooltip inside descriptions do not work.
Limited to toast and notification use cases.
data.setup_notes: Host the toaster in MaterialApp.builder using SileoToaster.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want simple native-looking toasts without custom layout widgets.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer heavily customizable modern toast notifications with rich styling options.

alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a highly flexible notification and overlay management system.
